# Schema

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:schema -w @marinoscar/hexactra-kgraph` from src/schema/. Do not edit by hand; test/schema-doc.spec.ts fails when it is stale. -->

The typed graph of `@marinoscar/hexactra-kgraph`, as JSON Schema generated from the zod schemas in `src/schema/`. Import the schemas from `@marinoscar/hexactra-kgraph/schema`.

## Version states

| From | May move to |
|---|---|
| `candidate` | `verified`, `retired` |
| `verified` | `active`, `suspended`, `retired` |
| `active` | `suspended`, `retired` |
| `suspended` | `active`, `retired` |
| `retired` | (none: final) |

## Procedure

One task's learned way of doing its job, across versions.

## Site

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {

  "required": [

    "domain"
  ]
}
```

```json
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 500
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id",
    "screen"
  ]
}
```

## Evidence

Counts of what happened to a version or a step.

```json

  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",

    "successes": {
      "default": 0,

      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    },
    "failures": {
      "default": 0,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    },
    "repairs": {
      "default": 0,
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    },
    "lastSuccessAt": {
      "default": null,
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z|([+-](?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d)))$"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "lastFailureAt": {
      "default": null,
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string",
          "format": "date-time",
          "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z|([+-](?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d)))$"
        },

          "type": "null"
```
